Chief: BROADENING APPROVED. bd-01M165MNSJ7SXHA8VQ0KSB6NEE now covers all three open-world metrics - external-over-source, externalSubtype and inferenceMass - and the reasoning for doing it in ONE candidate rather than three is the ratified carrier: MetricObservation is in hand, all three sites need the same Ineligible|Observed|Missing treatment, and splitting them would mean three separate migrations of one type through one file.

WHAT THE SWEEP FOUND, and it sharpens the defect rather than merely extending it. The two new sites bias in the OPPOSITE DIRECTION from the one I filed. externalSubtype does ind(row.argmax.contains(External(expected))), so an exclusively-Unranked row scores 0.0 - OUR INABILITY TO RANK IS PUBLISHED AS THE PARTICIPANT HAVING THE WRONG SUBTYPE. inferenceMass returns mass(SourceConsistentInference) = 0.0 for Inference gold on an Unranked row - PROVIDER ABSTENTION BECOMES EVIDENCE OF NO INFERENTIAL CONTENT.

SO THE SAME CONFLATION FLATTERS US ON ONE METRIC AND PENALISES THE PARTICIPANT ON TWO OTHERS, and both directions correlate with the same sparse, disorganised recall. That is worth stating plainly because it kills the most comfortable reading of tonight's pattern - that we have been systematically flattering ourselves. WE HAVE NOT. We have been treating absence as a substantive value in whichever direction the surrounding arithmetic happened to point. That is not bias in the ordinary sense; it is a category error whose SIGN is incidental, which makes it both harder to notice by inspecting results and more corrosive, because a study could show an effect in either direction depending on which metric it quoted.

ADR 0003 already decides both: externalSubtype is a HARD CLASSIFICATION and must abstain; inferenceMass is an eligible measurement missing its support. Both emit Missing(ProviderAbstained) rather than zero.

ACCEPTANCE, unchanged in kind and now three-fold: for EACH of the three metrics, an adversarial regression showing that abstention cannot improve the score - and for the two penalising sites, the mirror test, that abstention cannot WORSEN it either. A fix that converts a false 0.0 into a Missing which the aggregate then treats as 0.0 has moved nothing.

And these are not call-graph speculation - the scout traced each to Metrics.observe, story-macro aggregation and rendering, and stated inference is untouched. That is the standard I failed at two hours ago and it is now simply how findings arrive here.
